preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code. Derive the counted noun and whole population from source data and use them in both edited copy and notes. Identify the comparison base of relative changes.

edition-and-house-style.instruction: Identify the edition and editorial scope; record explicit house-style decisions and conflicts.

verify-applicable-passage.instruction: Apply an attributed book rule only after reading its relevant passage, including qualifications; otherwise mark it unverified.

consistent-decisions.instruction: Write every editable instance in the requested house form, including numbers in text and editorial notes. Scan both for the superseded form; only exact protected spans retain it.

bounded-attribution.instruction: Separate verified source-based changes, user house-style choices, and unresolved questions in an optional audit.
